description: Three npm projects (the SDK at the root, the docs site in web/, the UI gallery in gallery/), GitHub Actions, and the Biome version ci.yml pins. CI gates the root and web/; nothing builds gallery/ in CI, so its pull requests carry no check of their own. Lock-file refreshes stay off (the shared default): npm cannot hold a refresh to the 14-day wait.

packageRules.description: peerDependencies are the ranges every consumer of the published package installs against. Widening or raising one is a release decision recorded in the CHANGELOG, never a bot update.
web/ is the docs site, gated by the Docs site build job.
The SDK speaks the ext-apps protocol through these packages, and the client, core, server and ext-apps packages release against one another.
ci.yml pins setup-biome to the @biomejs/biome devDependency, so both move in one pull request.

customManagers.description: The Biome version the Lint job installs, which Renovate's github-actions manager does not read.
